description: An unmarked higher-order helper is conditioned by the same derivation as a marked one: the clean callback discharges and the throwing one is reported at its own call.

diagnostics.message: Call to `eachOf` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it is non-throwing given `cb`, and the argument passed for `cb` is throwing — its body was analyzed and can throw. `eachOf` enters `cb` at src/index.ts:2. Your outs: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`, or pass something non-throwing for `cb`.
